title: What if your teammates actually revived you?

lines.text: What if your teammates actually revived you?
You go down in the first fight, like always. Your teammates run past. One loots your chest. Then, for the first time in a hundred games, one turns around.
By mid-morning you're on your feet. He actually crouched. He actually waited the full ten seconds. You don't trust it. You check your health twice.
By noon the squad is unrecognizable. They share shields. They build a ramp before you ask. Someone says nice shot, and means it.
By sunset the storm closes in. Final circle, two squads left. And your teammates rotate with you, not away from you.
At night, you win. Your first win in a year. The screen says it. The group chat says nothing, because nobody can believe it.
So next match, when you go down in the first fight again, do they run back? Or was that the one time?
